meta.about: The prop catalogue (what each type is, how big, what it collides with, which variants a seed can pick) and every prop that stands on the block.
meta.readFrom: the running web game (window.__G, three.js r160), every module real

units.web: metres, seconds, radians; +Y up, north = -Z, east = +X (right-handed)
units.ue: centimetres, degrees; +Z up, X = east, Y = south (left-handed)

meta.conversion: ue (X, Y, Z) = web (x, z, y) * 100; ue yaw = atan2(web z, web x) of a direction = -rotationY of a prop, in degrees

frames.prop: a prop's origin is on the ground at the centre of its footprint; its catalogue length runs along its own +X, its height is up, its width along web +Z (Unreal +Y)
frames.yaw: ue.yaw assumes the Unreal mesh keeps that frame (mesh +X = the catalogue length axis). catalogue[type].front says which way the model's front looks in it; ue.frontYaw is the yaw of that front direction, i.e. the yaw for a mesh authored with its front on +X.

catalogue.source: G.config.catalog.PROPS (size, surface, flags), the file under src/props that registers the builder (family), and the factory itself: every type was built for seeds 0..47 (G.props.build) to count the shapes a seed can pick and the paints it draws, and each shape was measured. front follows docs/CONTRACT.md 6.2: vehicles and the hoop face +X, everything else with a front faces web +Z.

instances.source: placedBy 'level': every G.props.build call the level made (heard by lib/hooks.cjs), with the transform the level gave the result. placedBy 'explosives': G.level.explosives, which the explosives module draws from one built prop per type. role: dressing | objective (a master reel case) | extraction (the IPX truck) | explosive. Build the same prop in the web game with G.props.build(name, {...options, seed}).
